text:
Mira: Heads up - onboarding Sapphire7B (sapphire-7b) int4 smoke showed a weird vocab/normalization hiccup and a small rotary-scale delta. repro details below.
Devon: Can you paste the minimal repro and tokenizer dump?
Mira: Repro snippet: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('sapphire-vocab.json'); print(t.encode('—').ids)"` -> returns [5023] locally but our conversion expects 45. Also saw sequences where BOS token appears twice when the input contains U+2014.
Cheng: That smells like an NFKC/NFKD normalization difference between the upstream vocab and our conversion step. Also glanced at the exported rotary matrices - angles look scaled ~1.0014 vs upstream. Could be an export/transpose bug or a normalization factor applied during weight conversion.
Mira: Quick log from quant smoke: `./run_quant_smoke.sh sapphire int4` -> exit 0 but LAMBADA perplexity +12% vs float baseline, and a handful of answer token mismatches.
Devon: Run `./scripts/tokenmap-check --model sapphire --vocab` and attach the CSV. It catches common token-id collisions/aliases.
ops-bot: tokenmap-check completed: 2 collisions detected (U+2014 vs hyphen-minus combos). Suggested remap: s3://redwood/onboard/sapphire/token_remap.json
Cheng: Proposed action: 1) apply NFKC normalization in the conversion pipeline before token mapping, 2) apply token_remap for the two colliding entries, 3) tweak rotary_scale during loader to 0.9986 and re-quantize (small scaling sometimes compensates for exporter rounding). Also add an int4 per-channel calibration run.
Mira: I can try remap + normalization first (fast), then do rotary_scale experiment if perf doesn't recover. If remap fixes tokenization mismatch, that alone will likely recover most QA drift.
Devon: Also worth adding a tiny kvcache replay unit test - noticed an off-by-one happening on replay when the BOS duplication occurs. Stubbing that in tests will catch regressions.
Mira: Running remap+nfkc now. Will post outputs and a short diff of token counts.
ci-bot: nightly-smoke triggered for sapphire: job/6789 started (logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/6789)
Mira: quick result: after nfkc+remap => LAMBADA perplexity delta down to +3%, samples look aligned. Next: rotary tweak run on full quant bench.
Devon: Nice. After rotary run, let's schedule a small canary on dedicated for 24h with throttled traffic. If stable, mark sapphire as onboarded and add to model-catalog metadata (rotary_scale=0.9986, tokenizer_remap=s3://redwood/onboard/sapphire/token_remap.json).
Mira: Will update the onboarding doc at /onboard/sapphire/README.md and link the remap. Thanks team :thumbsup:
ops-bot: created ticket INF-2345 "Sapphire7B: token remap + rotary sanity" and attached logs.
